note: SL-at-fill rule effective for signals submitted after this instant; not retroactive (see ARENA_RULE_CHANGES.md)
gap_chase_note: DATA_GAP (quote gap >60 s at fill/miss decision), ABOVE-chase (>5% past trigger = MISSED) and INVALID_LEVELS (target at/below fill) apply to signals posted after this instant; not retroactive. Two earlier cases voided by ledger correction.
latency_note: Broker-like execution delay by dated steps in latency_schedule (20 s -> ... -> 1 s); a signal or management event gets the step in force at its own timestamp; never retroactive; both sides (owner's decisions 2026-10-26, 2026-10-29).
delete_after_fill_note: A channel post deleted AFTER its trade filled withdraws the call: market exit at the bid after the execution delay (like EXIT_NOW). Before the fill it still only cancels the order. Applies to events stamped at or after 2026-10-30 00:00 IST for every participant; not retroactive (owner's decision 2026-10-30, after the INSTITUTION_TRADER H00295 case).
